messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"book_code":"2ES","chapter":3,"verses":[{"verse":21,"chapter":3,"text":"For the first Adam, burdened with a wicked heart transgressed and was overcome, as were all who are descended from him."},{"verse":22,"chapter":3,"text":"Thus disease was made permanent. The law was in the heart of the people along with the wickedness of the root. So the good departed away and that which was wicked remained."},{"verse":23,"chapter":3,"text":"So the times passed away, and the years were brought to an end. Then you raised up a servant, called David,"},{"verse":24,"chapter":3,"text":"whom you commanded to build a city to your name, and to offer burnt offerings to you in it from what is yours."},{"verse":25,"chapter":3,"text":"When this was done many years, then those who inhabited the city did evil,"},{"verse":26,"chapter":3,"text":"in all things doing as Adam and all his generations had done, for they also had a wicked heart."},{"verse":27,"chapter":3,"text":"So you gave your city over into the hands of your enemies."},{"verse":28,"chapter":3,"text":"“Then I said in my heart, ‘Are their deeds of those who inhabit Babylon any better? Is that why it gained dominion over Zion?’"},{"verse":29,"chapter":3,"text":"For it came to pass when I came here, that I also saw impieties without number, and my soul saw many sinners in this thirtieth year, so that my heart failed me."},{"verse":30,"chapter":3,"text":"For I have seen how you endure them sinning, and have spared those who act ungodly, and have destroyed your people, and have preserved your enemies;"},{"verse":31,"chapter":3,"text":"and you have not shown how your way may be comprehended. Are the deeds of Babylon better than those of Zion?"},{"verse":32,"chapter":3,"text":"Or is there any other nation that knows you beside Israel? Or what tribes have so believed your covenants as these tribes of Jacob?"},{"verse":33,"chapter":3,"text":"Yet their reward doesn’t appear, and their labor has no fruit, for I have gone here and there through the nations, and I see that they abound in wealth, and don’t think about your commandments."},{"verse":34,"chapter":3,"text":"Weigh therefore our iniquities now in the balance, and theirs also who dwell in the world, and so will it be found which way the scale inclines."},{"verse":35,"chapter":3,"text":"Or when was it that they who dwell on the earth have not sinned in your sight? Or what nation has kept your commandments so well?"},{"verse":36,"chapter":3,"text":"You will find some men by name who have kept your precepts, but you won’t find nations.”"}]}
